description: This Java source file defines the ServerConfig class, which extends AbstractConfig and encapsulates configuration properties for server network settings, including port numbers, bind addresses, TLS requirements, and insecure port configurations within the org.eclipse.hono.config package.

classes.name: ServerConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for network server properties, including port settings, bind addresses, TLS requirements, and insecure port options.

methods.name: getBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the host name or IP address of the network interface to which the server's secure port is bound.

methods.name: setBindAddress
methods.description: Sets the host name or IP address of the network interface for the server's secure port.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the secure port number the server is configured to listen on.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the secure port number or default if not explicitly set.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the secure port number for the server, validating the port range.

methods.name: isSecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the server's secure port is configured with a valid key and certificate.

methods.name: isNativeTlsRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether native TLS implementation is required.

methods.name: setNativeTlsRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the server should require native TLS implementation.

methods.name: isInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks if insecure port support is enabled.

methods.name: setInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables support for insecure ports.

methods.name: getInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the insecure port.

methods.name: setInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Sets the bind address for the insecure port.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Retrieves the insecure port number the server is configured to listen on.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Retrieves the insecure port number or default if not explicitly set.

methods.name: setInsecurePort
methods.description: Sets the insecure port number and enables insecure port support.
